info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Retail Orders Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Status API provides developers with the ability to retrieve the current status of retail orders. This endpoint serves as a valuable resource for stakeholders, including retailers and customer service teams, seeking insights into order fulfillment and processing. By leveraging this API, users can efficiently monitor order statuses, facilitating better customer communication and inventory management. Typical use cases include tracking outstanding orders and providing real-time updates to customers regarding their purchases.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of an order.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to check the status of a specific order by its unique identifier. A successful response will provide detailed information about the order status, including any pending actions or updates.
